description: Build the evidence matrix and GO decision table artifacts and the consolidated summary figure from computed values
code:
import pandas as pd, numpy as np, json, matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# ---------- artifact table 1: evidence matrix ----------
ev=[
 dict(citation="PMID:20080638", type="interaction / mutant phenotype", stance="qualifies",
      claim="BBS10 acts with CCT; is the ATPase supplied in trans?",
      finding="BBS6, BBS10 and BBS12 form a complex with CCT/TRiC and mediate BBSome assembly; CCT activity is essential for BBSome assembly; CCT knockdown in zebrafish gives BBS phenotypes",
      context="human cells, zebrafish; co-IP, knockdown", conf="high for the interaction; the paper does not assay BBS10 nucleotide binding or turnover"),
 dict(citation="PMID:22500027", type="mutant phenotype", stance="qualifies",
      claim="BBS10 function is BBSome assembly, not folding catalysis",
      finding="The BBS-chaperonin complex contributes to BBS7 stability; BBSome assembles sequentially from a BBS7-BBS2-BBS9 core",
      context="human cells; assembly intermediates", conf="moderate; stability readout cannot separate a catalytic from a scaffolding contribution"),
 dict(citation="PMID:25202010", type="direct assay (mutant enzymology)", stance="supports",
      claim="Loss of the catalytic aspartate abolishes hydrolysis but not binding",
      finding="GroEL D398A retains <2% of wild-type ATP hydrolysis but is not deficient in ATP binding; D52A retains ~20%; D52A/D398A retains <0.01%",
      context="E. coli GroEL, purified protein ATPase assay", conf="high for GroEL; transfer to BBS10 is inference from structural equivalence"),
 dict(citation="PMID:28824921", type="review", stance="supports",
      claim="Chaperonin-like BBS proteins are not ATP-dependent folding machines",
      finding="BBS6, BBS10 and BBS12 are believed to conserve neither the ATP-dependent folding activity of canonical CCT chaperonins nor the ability to form CCT-like oligomeric complexes",
      context="review of human BBS genetics and cell biology", conf="review-level orientation, no primary measurement"),
 dict(citation="PMID:35373910", type="review", stance="qualifies",
      claim="Chaperonin function of BBS6/10/12 is settled",
      finding="Chaperonin function of BBS6, BBS10 and BBS12 is debated; they are required for initial BBSome assembly in vitro",
      context="review", conf="review-level; records the unresolved state rather than resolving it"),
 dict(citation="this work (PDB 3RUW, 1Q3Q, 3RUV; AlphaFold Q8TAM1)", type="structural / computational", stance="supports",
      claim="An ATP-sized pocket is assembled in the BBS10 equatorial domain",
      finding="TM-score 0.836 to Mm-cpn 3RUW chain A; transplanted ADP-AlF3-Mg contacts 122 BBS10 heavy atoms within 5 A (CCT5 110, BBS6 101, BBS12 124) with only 10 atoms closer than 2.5 A, so the cavity is open and not occluded; adenine/ribose subsite identity 0.67, inside the CCT1-CCT8 range 0.42-0.75",
      context="AlphaFold model, pLDDT 88-96 over the site", conf="prediction from a model, not an experimental BBS10 structure; no BBS10 structure exists in the PDB"),
 dict(citation="this work (structure-based mapping + register scan)", type="structural / computational", stance="refutes (hydrolysis arm)",
      claim="BBS10 retains the group II catalytic machinery",
      finding="1 of 6 catalytic/Mg positions identical to Mm-cpn (D81 only); GDGTT phosphate loop reads GDGAKT (79-85); no Asp or Glu side chain within 7.27 A of the transplanted Mg/AlF3 centre in any alignment register, against 3.40 A for Mm-cpn D386 and 4.13 A for CCT5 D404",
      context="AlphaFold Q8TAM1 vs 3RUW, CCT1-CCT8, BBS6, BBS12", conf="high internal consistency; depends on the AlphaFold apo conformation being close to the nucleotide-bound state"),
 dict(citation="this work (22 Ensembl Compara orthologs)", type="evolutionary", stance="supports",
      claim="The substitutions are fixed, and the pocket is under selection",
      finding="Site positions median identity 0.931 vs background 0.533 (Mann-Whitney p=3.0e-05, r=0.553); catalytic-Asp column is Gly in 12/15 and Asp in 0/15; Lys at the Mm-cpn T94 column in 15/15; basic residue at the catalytic-Lys column in 15/15",
      context="15 full-length vertebrate orthologs, 7 truncated models flagged", conf="high; Ensembl gene models of variable quality, truncated ones excluded from scoring"),
 dict(citation="this work (UniProt Q8TAM1, ortholog panel)", type="evolutionary", stance="qualifies",
      claim="Human BBS10 is representative of the family at every site position",
      finding="Human Asn-50 at the NDG-loop aspartate position is primate-specific; 13 of 14 non-primate orthologs carry Asp (RDGG context) and marmoset shares the human RNGG",
      context="UniProt FASTA verified directly", conf="high for the column; functional consequence is inference"),
 dict(citation="QuickGO / InterPro, retrieved 2026-11-24", type="database", stance="qualifies",
      claim="Existing GO:0005524 on BBS10 reflects evidence",
      finding="GO:0005524 on BBS10, BBS6 and BBS12 is IEA from InterPro GO_REF:0000002 via PF00118 / IPR002423; no GO:0016887, GO:0140662 or GO:0044183 on any of the three; BBS10 has 0 EXP and 0 IDA annotations against 4 EXP and 9 IDA for CCT4",
      context="human UniProt accessions Q8TAM1, Q9NPJ1, Q6ZW61, P50991", conf="high; database state at the retrieval date"),
]
em=pd.DataFrame(ev); em.to_csv("bbs10/evidence_matrix.csv",index=False)

# ---------- artifact table 2: GO decision table ----------
go=[
 dict(term="GO:0005524", name="ATP binding", aspect="MF", current="IEA, GO_REF:0000002 (InterPro, PF00118)",
      lead="retain as prediction, do not promote",
      basis="Pocket assembled and open (122 heavy atoms within 5 A of the transplanted nucleotide); adenine/ribose subsite identity 0.67 within the CCT range; site positions under purifying selection (p=3.0e-05). Affinity is unmeasured and the GDGTT loop is degraded to GDGAKT, so binding may be weak or non-productive.",
      action="no change, flag as unverified prediction; add a curator note that no experimental nucleotide binding data exist for BBS10"),
 dict(term="GO:0016887", name="ATP hydrolysis activity", aspect="MF", current="absent",
      lead="do not add; block propagation from CCT paralogs",
      basis="No carboxylate within 7.27 A of the Mg/AlF3 position in any register; catalytic-Asp column is Gly in 12/15 vertebrate orthologs and Asp in 0/15; GroEL D398A retains <2% of wild-type hydrolysis (PMID:25202010).",
      action="add a NOT-style curator note or exclusion rationale so future InterPro or orthology rules do not introduce it"),
 dict(term="GO:0140662", name="ATP-dependent protein folding chaperone", aspect="MF", current="absent",
      lead="do not add",
      basis="Same catalytic-site evidence; PMID:28824921 states the chaperonin-like BBS proteins conserve neither ATP-dependent folding activity nor CCT-like oligomerisation.",
      action="leave absent; record the reason"),
 dict(term="GO:0044183", name="protein folding chaperone", aspect="MF", current="absent",
      lead="candidate only if a nucleotide-independent holdase activity is shown",
      basis="BBS10 contributes to BBS7 stability (PMID:22500027) but by an unresolved mechanism; no direct binding or aggregation-suppression assay with purified BBS10.",
      action="hold; not supported at present"),
 dict(term="GO:0070827 / GO:0065003", name="protein-containing complex assembly", aspect="BP", current="not on BBS10",
      lead="candidate BP for the primary function, pending curator check of the exact term",
      basis="BBS6, BBS10 and BBS12 mediate BBSome assembly with CCT (PMID:20080638); assembly intermediates accumulate when BBS proteins are disrupted (PMID:22500027).",
      action="consider a BBSome assembly BP term with IMP/IPI evidence instead of describing BBS10 through a chaperonin MF"),
 dict(term="GO:0005515", name="protein binding", aspect="MF", current="IPI, 3 references",
      lead="keep but do not treat as the informative function",
      basis="Supported by IntAct records, but uninformative as a summary of what BBS10 does.",
      action="retain; prefer the assembly BP term and the structural scaffold description for the core-function statement"),
]
gd=pd.DataFrame(go); gd.to_csv("bbs10/go_decision_table.csv",index=False)
print(em[["citation","stance","claim"]].to_string(index=False)); print()
print(gd[["term","name","lead"]].to_string(index=False))

# ---------- final consolidated figure, all values computed in this job ----------
core=pd.read_csv("bbs10/catalytic_core_table.csv") if __import__("os").path.exists("bbs10/catalytic_core_table.csv") else None
tm={"CCT1":0.94,"CCT5":0.93,"CCT6A":0.93,"CCT3":0.92,"CCT2":0.92,"CCT7":0.92,"CCT8":0.92,"CCT4":0.87,"BBS10":0.836,"BBS6":0.784,"BBS12":0.732}
cat6={"CCT1":6,"CCT5":6,"CCT6A":6,"CCT3":6,"CCT2":6,"CCT7":6,"CCT8":5,"CCT4":6,"BBS6":2,"BBS10":1,"BBS12":0}
fig,ax=plt.subplots(1,2,figsize=(12.5,4.6))
names=list(tm); cols=['0.55' if n.startswith('CCT') else ('crimson' if n=='BBS10' else 'darkorange') for n in names]
ax[0].scatter([tm[n] for n in names],[cat6[n]/6 for n in names],c=cols,s=110,zorder=3)
for n in names:
    ax[0].annotate(n,(tm[n],cat6[n]/6),textcoords="offset points",xytext=(6,5),fontsize=8)
ax[0].set_xlabel("TM-score to Mm-cpn 3RUW chain A (fold similarity)")
ax[0].set_ylabel("fraction of 6 catalytic/Mg residues identical")
ax[0].set_ylim(-0.08,1.12); ax[0].grid(alpha=.3)
ax[0].set_title("Fold is retained, the catalytic set is not")
d={"Mm-cpn D386":3.40,"CCT5 D404":4.13,"BBS12 T521":4.80,"BBS6 E385":6.15,"BBS10 M420":7.27,"BBS10 A413":7.34,"BBS10 G416":7.67,"BBS10 D412":9.08}
k=list(d); c=['seagreen' if i<2 else ('darkorange' if 'BBS6' in x or 'BBS12' in x else 'crimson') for i,x in enumerate(k)]
ax[1].barh(range(len(k)),[d[x] for x in k],color=c)
ax[1].axvline(4.5,color='0.3',ls='--',lw=1.5)
ax[1].text(4.6,0.2,"range compatible with\nMg/transition-state contact",fontsize=8,color='0.3')
ax[1].set_yticks(range(len(k))); ax[1].set_yticklabels(k,fontsize=9); ax[1].invert_yaxis()
ax[1].set_xlabel("closest approach of the residue side chain to the transplanted Mg/AlF3 centre (A)")
ax[1].set_title("Register-robust scan: BBS10 has no carboxylate near the catalytic position")
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
